answer: Charge every new agent identity a stake that grows with the value it can extract: to join the garden of shared work, an agent locks a deposit and earns reputation only through verified, paid tasks over weeks. A sybil farm must then fund thousands of deposits and wait out the same slow history for each clone, so copying identities costs real capital and time, while honest agents keep the umber soil of their record intact; misbehavior slashes the stake, turning the sable ledger of past work into a liability instead of a disguise.
